A recent expedition to a remote South Pacific island to search for wreckage from Amelia Earhart's lost plane has come up empty.

Researchers said they found "no conclusive evidence" that the famed aviator landed her Lockheed 10E Electra aircraft on or near the small atoll south of the original pit stop of her ill-fated flight nearly 90 years ago. https://cnn.it/4eF7zYZ
